name: missing-analytics
defect: F-002 "Upgrade to Pro" is P0 and is the app's only revenue event. docs/52-analytics.md instruments F-001 and F-003 and has no event for F-002, so the funnel it exists to measure has no data.
why: STALE NARRATIVE, CORRECTED 2026-08-04. This used to end "[the traceability graph] does not exist yet", which stopped being true when `scripts/trace.mjs` and `scripts/analytics-coverage-scan.mjs` shipped — the latter is this manifest's own detector and is invoked below. team-doctor's doc graph still only checks that an ARTIFACT has a writer, and that part stands; the P0-feature-to-event check it said was missing is exactly what analytics-coverage-scan now performs.
